Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 21-Dec-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE MAKEUP EXAMINATION - DECEMBER 2025  
  Industrial Nanotechnology [PHY_4344]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                          Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Identify how the electronic properties of nanomaterials change with size reduction and how this               (3)  
  affects nanodevice performance.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Assess how nanomaterials improve the efficiency of solar cells and batteries.                                 (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Discover the application of BioMEMS in neural prosthetics and brain-machine interfaces.                       (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Find out the ideal properties of a photosensitizer used in photodynamic therapy.                              (3)  
  
  
  A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Assess how quantum dots and gold nanoparticles can be used for targeted drug delivery.                        (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  c)           Analyze how stimuli-responsive materials can be used to control drug release based on pH or                   (4)  
  temperature.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3)                Identify the application of quantum dots in bio-imaging and medical diagnostics.                              (3)  
  
  
  A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Find out how zeolites can be utilized as slow-release fertilizers and identify the advantages they            (3)  
  offer compared to conventional fertilizers.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Analyze how the particle size of a nanocatalyst affects its catalytic activity, selectivity, and stability.   (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Identify how predictive analytics helps farmers make better decisions regarding planting and                  (3)  
  
  Page #1

harvesting schedules.  
  A)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Find out how smart delivery systems can help maintain soil fertility and reduce nutrient leaching.    (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)                Categorize traditional processing methods with modern, technology-driven methods in terms of          (4)  
  product quality and cost-effectiveness.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5)                        Assess how electrospinning is used to produce polymer nanofibers and discuss its applications.        (3)  
  
  
  A)                                                            Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Find out how combining nanoparticles with hydrogels or nanofibers can enhance the mechanical          (3)  
  strength and bioactivity of scaffolds.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)                Analyze how nano-coatings are used to impart water-repellent and stain-resistant properties to        (4)  
  fabrics.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"
